original: Small front-facing long tapered blue eel on transparent canvas, with a broad blunt head at the bottom and a narrow body running upward toward a yellow curved tail.
Cyan upper/outer planes, darker blue central/lower planes, thin central yellow dorsal strip, two short yellow side fins, white eyes with navy pupils and small glints, and a short straight dark mouth.
Silhouette and color boundaries are sharply faceted. Face and fins read as simple separate forms; highlights and rounded transitions are limited.
fixed_target: The same recognizable blue/yellow eel identity becomes a fuller, more rounded cartoon body, with more substantial yellow fins and a broad curved tail.
A plumper muzzle, large forward white eyes with deep navy pupils, raised blue eye surrounds and a small curved smiling mouth give the face clearer volume and expression.

Broad cyan-to-deep-blue gradients, white eye/nose glints, soft blue rims and warm yellow fin edge highlights produce a polished softly lit appearance. Body planes remain organized, while transitions and silhouette are substantially softer.
The central yellow strip is more visible and rounded. Fin surfaces have thickness-like edge lighting and gentle internal volume.
global_style: The reference plant and warm gold pot use saturated, grouped color masses; softly shaded volumes; controlled facets; rounded pot edges; and warm bright edge/highlight accents.
The strongest transferable cues are readable simple forms, soft light/shadow transitions and deliberate highlights. The global plant palette is not a reason to change the eel blue/yellow identity.
bounded_comparison: Useful native opportunities are facial volume and expression, smoother body/fin transitions, purposeful thickness and curvature, and broad controlled highlights while preserving the eel identity.

Target pixels are an aesthetic reference only. This inspection establishes no future capture resolution, camera, object size, silhouette envelope, interface requirement or registration lock from those pixels.
Original part counts, low polygon counts and existing shaders are observed starting data, not automatic aesthetic restrictions.

native_ownership.ownership: All 15 enumerated objects belong to this exact own collection. Root -> constant canonical_S_facing empty -> armature -> all 12 mesh objects. No socket helper or foot object is present.
native_ownership.root_properties: Actual root is at zero translation/rotation with unit scale. Raw canonical_front is S=-Y; constant inner orientation is 180 degrees. Footprint/visual-height/camera data are raw observations awaiting coordinator reconciliation, not newly frozen requirements.
native_ownership.floating_actor: No presumed feet or ground-support obligation is added.

geometry.body: continuous_body: 290 vertices/282 polygons; continuous_dorsal_fin: 87/84. Both are weighted along spine_0..spine_6.
geometry.face: Two separate eye whites and pupils use 42-vertex/80-polygon meshes each; glints use 12/20 each. Mouth raw mesh is 8/6 with an evaluated bevel and armature modifier.
geometry.fins: Each side fin raw mesh is 4 vertices/4 polygons with blended spine_1..3 weights. Tail fin is 16/14 weighted entirely to spine_6.
geometry.totals: 601 raw mesh vertices and 754 raw polygons. All raw polygons report use_smooth false; no shape keys are present. Body/dorsal/fins have no UV layer; eye/mouth primitives have UVMap.
geometry.deformation: All 12 meshes have the own armature modifier. Eye/glint/mouth weights are entirely spine_0; body and dorsal have blended adjacent spine weights.

rig.rest_chain: Seven connected parented deform bones run from local (0,0.52,0.44) to (0,-1,0.44). Pose position is POSE. No bone constraints were found.
rig.saved_state: Original armature has animation_data with no active action, no NLA tracks and no drivers. Saved bones use QUATERNION mode with identity quaternion and basis; saved nonzero Euler values are inactive in that mode.

actions.record_source: Actual own root native_action_record; no helper read.
actions.channel_semantics: Each action targets armature object location/rotation_euler and all seven pose bone location/rotation_euler/scale channels. Exact native slot targets own armature.
actions.ranges: normal/swim/aim/restless/pursuit/weave/dash/pause have keys at integer frames 1..13; hook/caught/escape at 1..12. Root recipes say 12 exported frames at 12 fps; first eight loop, last three do not.
actions.raw_evaluation_finding: With exact action slots and unchanged saved modes, frames 1,4,12 change Euler channel values but each bone quaternion remains identity and basis remains identity. Evaluated spine bends therefore do not follow those keyed Euler values; visible/evaluated movement in these samples comes from armature object translation/rotation. This is a source inconsistency observed independently, not a proposed repair or approved future contract.
actions.sample_limit: 33 sampled action/frame evaluations; not a full 12-frame or four-facing behavior verification.

sockets.semantics: Hook and cable share root-property coordinates [0,-0.16,0.56]; nose is [0,-0.6,0.44]. No dedicated attachment object or animated socket is present in own native collection. Runtime interpretation remains for later coordinator reconciliation.

bounded_native_observations.materials: Six own palette materials: blue, blue_dark, cream, yellow, white and navy. Active surface link is from Principled BSDF.001; roughness is 0.85, specular IOR level about 0.03 and coat zero, with procedural color input. Old named nodes/custom metadata do not establish future lighting or material restrictions.
